compression_level.description: Compression level from 1 to 19. Higher levels increase ratio but decrease speed.

threads.description: Number of worker threads. 0 attempts to detect physical CPU cores.

integrity_check.description: Add integrity check (XXH64) to the compressed frame.

keep_source.description: Keep the source file after successful compression.

output_dir.description: Directory to store resulting files. If empty, defaults to source directory.

recursive.description: Operate recursively on directories if input is a directory.

files.description: List of files or directories to compress.
